page.overview:
Who is Shiadhal?

Shiadhal was an Aen Elle, the consort of King Auberon Muircetach and the mother of Lara Dorren. Titled the Winter Queen after her distant ancestor, she led the Wild Hunt, Dearg Ruadhri, before Eredin.

Shiadhal was born as part of the multi-generational Elder Blood breeding program intended to produce the Swallow, person who would be able to open the Ard Gaeth.

Her father was Shaerram Dorren, an Aen Elle Sage, and Narien, in whom the Aen Ghele and Aen Nílfe branches of the bloodline were mixed. This strenghtened the Elder Blood gene enough for Shiadhal to be able to lead the Dearg Ruadhri across the Spiral once she grew up. She was able to summon the elemental hounds from the Plane of Ice, which would then become the Hunt's useful allies.

After marrying Auberon Muircetach, she honored the Aen Ghele part of her heritage by assuming the title of the Winter Queen.
